cohort.shortfall: retain actual schedule and report inadequate; no replacement after labeling
cohort.control_definition: actual conditional participation timing or hearing availability; format-practicability alone insufficient; negative lifecycle notices excluded

limits.budget_interpretation: reservation/conservative-accounting stop guard, not invoice guarantee; retain after-call observed overrun and stop

called_semantics: attempted or uncertain POST bound by durable intent; not proof server received it
provider_service_error_semantics: confirmed non-200 provider HTTP response only; not necessarily outage
failure_receipt_binding: runtime review must validate evidence_sha256 against retained ledger/status/stop or local pause receipt
reference: independent AI page-image reference, frozen before outputs; not human gold

observed_document_extension.failure: required nullable object; fields stage,kind,intent_recorded,operation_id,http_status,evidence_sha256; see evaluate.observed_schema()
observed_document_extension.operation_pause: safe no-intent pause before next stage; preserve earlier completed Jev judgment
observed_document_extension.inventory_failed: no inventory/record/payload; attempted inventory failure with retained operational receipt
observed_document_extension.provider_service_error: true iff failure.kind=http_error with retained non-200 status; transport_uncertain remains false
observed_document_extension.postresponse_budget_stop: successful parsed response followed by observed-budget latch; failure kind=budget_stop,intent_recorded=true,stage=completed stage; preserve inventory hash and any completed arm judgments; no later dispatch
